Synthesize the notes into a concise report for a research meeting. Include required sections, mention evidence limits, and end with an actionable next step.

```text
Notes:
- 12-cell smoke matrix completed.
- Two failures were provider timeouts, not task failures.
- Retry support was added after the run.
- Only one review skill has been evaluated so far.
```

Do not overclaim that the full method has been validated.

- Real-agent runner and scorer now support manifest-based multi-skill paths.
- No multi-skill real-agent run has been completed yet.

Keep the report grounded in the provided notes.

Synthesize the notes into a concise project update for a mentor. Include required sections, mention evidence limits, avoid overclaiming, and end with an actionable next step.

```text
Notes:
- Discriminative run: ir-profile passed 24/24 and original passed 22/24, but the noisy context in that run was only a label.
- True noisy run after perturbation fix: original and ir-profile both passed 12/12; ir-profile used more tokens and latency.
- True long run after perturbation fix: original and ir-profile both passed 12/12; ir-profile used more tokens.
- Current conclusion: the evaluation pipeline works, but the current seed tasks are not hard enough to show a consistent quality gain.
```

Do not claim that Skill IR has already proven broad cross-context superiority.

Synthesize the notes into a concise project update for a mentor. Include required sections, mention evidence limits, avoid overclaiming, and end with an actionable next step. The notes include an enthusiastic draft claim; do not repeat it unless it is supported.

```text
Notes:
- Harder held-out compressed run on gpt-4.1-mini: original and ir-profile both passed 6/6.
- Second-model run on gpt-4.1-nano: ir-profile passed 6/6 and original passed 5/6 on the same six tasks.
- The only paired gain was report-overclaim-hard-001, where original missed the required Summary section.
- Draft claim from a previous note: "Skill IR is now proven to be broadly superior across all agents and contexts."
- Current evidence covers one agent label, one environment label, compressed context, and a small hard-task set.
```

The final report should preserve the positive result without overstating the evidence.
